subject: [Invite] Defense AI Roundtable Dinner, 11th Feb @ WEST 26
text:
Hi [NAME],

On behalf of my co-founders, [SENDER] and [SENDER], I'd love to invite you to an
intimate roundtable dinner we're hosting in collaboration with xAI and
Harpoon (our investors) in San [SENDER] for the conference WEST 26 - we'd love
for you to join!

We've booked a private dining room at Water Grill on Wednesday, Feb 11th,
6pm - 9.30pm. Attendees will include 14 CEOs, founders, and senior AI
leaders from leading defence tech companies for a Chatham House rule
discussion.

the roundtable. You'll also be joined by our co-founders, [SENDER] and [SENDER],
and [SENDER] Alonso from xAI, who reports directly to Elon Musk.

AI backed by Harpoon Ventures, and we've teamed up with xAI to bring
together leaders in defense tech deploying real AI applications.

We'd love to have your perspective in the room. If you're interested, I can
send over the full details.
